SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
Sol, Special Branch. XXXXX
REPORT
Date October 27, 1938.
Subject Chinese Students Returned From Abroad to form Federation.
Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by

Arrangements are being made by the following persons
to form a "Federation of Chinese Students Returned From
Abroad" (中國留學生總會):-
1. Mr. Loo Sih Yoong (盧榮), Principal of the New China
University, 183 Nanyang Road.
2. Mr. Ting Vung Mao (丁文彩), Professor of the Ellis Ka-
doorie Public School for Chinese.
3. Mr. Wu Tse Chien (吳志騫), Principal of the Shanghai
Girls University, 451 Taku Road.
4. Wu Yah Shuin (吳雅薰), Professor of the Shanghai Girls
University, 451 Taku Road.
5. Mr. Chien Wei Tsoong (錢慰宗), Principal of the Duo
Kwang Middle School, corner of Avenue and Carter Roads.
6. Lan Yah Koo (藍楮柯), employee of the Belgian Consulate-
General.
7. Mr. Wu Yih Ts (吳益之), Proctor of the Shanghai Girls
University, 451 Taku Road.
8. Mr. Hu Yao Mei (胡耀梅), Principal of the New China
College, 7/1292 Avenue Edward VII.

According to the promoters, who, at present, have an
office established in the Shanghai Girls University, 451 Taku
Road, the proposed Federation will have for its aim, the
promotion of research in arts and science and the cultivation
of friendship among its members. The promoters have decided
to hold a dinner party in the Medium Club, 674 Weihaiwei Road,
at 6.30 p.m., October 29, 1938 when some fifty persons are
expected to attend.

It will be noted that the majority of the promoters are
either principals or faculty members of the universities and
colleges which came into existence in Shanghai after the
outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1937. These

报告
日期：1938年10月27日。
主题：归国留学生组建联合会。
制作人：副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien） 转呈人：

以下人士正着手组建“中国留学生总会”（Federation of Chinese Students Returned From Abroad）：
1. 卢荣（Loo Sih Yoong）先生，新华大学校长，地址：南阳路183号。
2. 丁文彩（Ting Vung Mao）先生，埃利斯·卡杜里公立华童公学教授。
3. 吴志騫（Wu Tse Chien）先生，上海女子大学校长，地址：大沽路451号。
4. 吴雅薰（Wu Yah Shuin），上海女子大学教授，地址：大沽路451号。
5. 钱慰宗（Chien Wei Tsoong）先生，多光中学校长，地址：爱文义路与卡特路（Carter Roads）转角。
6. 蓝楮柯（Lan Yah Koo），比利时总领事馆雇员。
7. 吴益之（Wu Yih Ts）先生，上海女子大学舍监，地址：大沽路451号。
8. 胡耀梅（Hu Yao Mei）先生，新华学院院长，地址：爱文义路7/1292号。

据发起人称，他们目前在位于大沽路451号的上海女子大学内设有办事处，拟议中的联合会旨在促进文理学术研究，并增进会员间的友谊。发起人决定于1938年10月29日下午6时30分，在威海卫路674号的中社（Medium Club）举行晚宴，预计约有五十人出席。

值得注意的是，大多数发起人或是1937年中日敌对行动爆发后在上海成立的各大学和学院的校长或教职员。这些

persons are not regarded with much respect in Chinese educational
circles but are branded as opportunists for having established
their institutions at a time when numerous old universities
and colleges were either destroyed as a result of the
hostilities, or compelled to suspend their operations either
wholly or partially.
In order to elevate their positions in the educational
world the principals and faculty members of the new universities
and colleges recently united and formed a "Shanghai New
Universities Association" (Vide Special Branch Report dated
19/10/38) whose object it is to improve the administration and
protect the interests of the member-schools. The present
movement undertaken by them to form a "Federation of Chinese
Returned Students from Abroad" is another step aiming at the
same goal. Through the medium of the Federation they expect
to establish friendship with the Chinese returned students
from abroad who form the upper stratum of the educational
circles in Shanghai.
D.C. (Special Branch)

为了提升其在教育界的地位，这些新办大学和学院的校长及教职员近期联合成立了“上海新大学协会”（参见1938年10月19日的特科报告），其宗旨是改善管理并保护成员学校的利益。他们目前发起组建“中国归国留学生联合会”的运动，是朝着同一目标迈出的又一步。他们期望通过该联合会，与构成上海教育界上层的归国留学生建立友谊。
